verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official 'Inso CLI' documented for automating collection runs, linting OpenAPI specs, and running in CI pipelines with exit codes for pass/fail, which is exactly the kind of scriptable, agent-friendly interface an AI-native workflow would use. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of Inso CLI usage and explicit framing of the CLI as AI/agent-oriented rather than just human CI tooling.
